after.zh: 池化把位置丢掉了一部分，反池化把它找回来：亮点在 2×2 块里的哪一格，信息还在池化前的图里。
after.en: Pooling throws part of the position away, and unpooling gets it back: which cell of the 2×2 block the dot was in is still in the picture before pooling.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-9-3"></part-ref>把池化后的每个值放回池化前它所在的那一格，其余格子为 0。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-9-3"></part-ref> in the tray puts each pooled value back in the cell it came from before pooling; every other cell is 0.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：池化一张亮点图再放大回来，每个亮点要回到原处。
t.en: Your task in this level: pool a picture of bright dots and enlarge it back, with every dot returning to its place.

brief.zh: 一张稀疏的亮点图先做 2×2 最大池化，再放大回 16×16，每个亮点要回到原来的位置。
brief.en: A picture of sparse bright dots goes through 2×2 max pooling, then back up to 16×16, and every dot must return to where it was.

hint.zh: 一放大，每个点就糊成一整块。
hint.en: Enlarge it and every dot smears into a whole block.
